title.narrative: UNICEF supported 442,011 children (65% girls) through 13,971 Community-Based Education classes in remote and underserved areas, ensuring access to quality education for marginalized children. To strengthen the public education system, 1.1 million children (41% girls) in Grades 1?3 received individual learning kits, while 28,038 teachers (39% female) were supported with instructional materials. Additionally, 284,617 students received textbooks and early grade readers were distributed to 15,000 public schools, enhancing learning outcomes and promoting resilience among children affected by crisis and limited education access.
